title: Provable Selective Auto-labeling with Reliability Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2510.14581v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Auto-labeling has emerged as a popular, cost-effective alternative to manual annotation. However, its performance is often highly inconsistent across different tasks, underscoring the importance of selective strategies. Despite this, existing heuristic methods for selective auto-labeling still rely heavily on model confidence scores and offer no reliable guarantee on the trustworthiness of the selected examples. To address this, we propose \textbf{Conformal Labeling}, a novel method that selects a subset of auto-generated labels with a provably controlled false labeling rate (FLR). Our key idea is to formulate selective auto-labeling as a multiple-hypothesis testing problem, where each hypothesis indicates whether to accept the auto-generated label for an instance. Specifically, we construct a conformal $p$-value for each auto-generated label using a small calibration set, and then employ the Benjamini--Hochberg (BH) procedure

translated_title: 具有可靠性保证的可证明选择性自动标注
translated_abstract: 自动标注已成为一种流行且经济高效的人工标注替代方案。然而，其性能在不同任务间往往存在高度不一致性，这凸显了选择性策略的重要性。尽管如此，现有的选择性自动标注启发式方法仍然严重依赖模型置信度分数，并且对所选样本的可信度无法提供可靠的保证。为解决这一问题，我们提出了共形标注，这是一种新颖的方法，能够选择一个自动生成标签的子集，并对其错误标注率进行可证明的控制。我们的核心思想是将选择性自动标注形式化为一个多重假设检验问题，其中每个假设表示是否接受某个实例的自动生成标签。具体而言，我们使用小型校准集为每个自动生成的标签构建共形p值，然后采用Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）程序……
tldr: 提出了“共形标注”这一新方法，将选择性自动标注形式化为多重假设检验问题，通过构建共形p值并结合Benjamini-Hochberg程序，在错误标注率可证明受控的前提下筛选出可信的自动生成标签子集。
en_tdlr: Proposes "Conformal Labeling," a novel method that formulates selective auto-labeling as a multiple-hypothesis testing problem, using conformal p-values with the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure to select trustworthy auto-generated labels with a provably controlled false labeling rate.
